newsitem.title: USA: EG&G, InVision in strategic pact.
newsitem.headline: EG&G, InVision in strategic pact.

text.p: EG&G Inc subsidiary EG&G Astrophysics Corp said on Wednesday it entered into a strategic alliance with InVision Technologies Inc, to develop and market an advanced explosives detection system.
Under the agreement, EG&G Inc would invest $2 million in InVision, in exchange for 91,885 InVision common stock.

The companies aim to develop a system which would combine InVision CTX 5000's detection capability with the quick-scanning powers of EG&G's Z-SCAN. The Z-SCAN could scan up to 1800 pieces of luggage an hour, EG&G said.
Both EG&G Astrophysics and InVision make aviation security equipment.
The combined system was expected to be produced by the summer of 1997 and available for airports worldwide by the end of 1997, EG&G said.
